verdict.rationale: Evidence confirms a dedicated 'Fivetran Alerts' feature (docs-15), a webhooks mechanism for usage/event data (docs-47), and an MCP tool that lets you query 'when was the last time my postgres connection completed a sync?' and 'are any of my connections broken?' (docs-28), indicating run-status visibility and some failure notification capability. However, the pack lacks detail on the specific alert channels (Slack, email) being supported, and there is no evidence of per-sync row-count reporting or log inspection UI. missing for 10: explicit Slack/email alert channel documentation, per-sync row count visibility, detailed log viewer evidence.
